esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3742 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.835 + 0.971×ln(VIX) + 0.315×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
